title: Postgres: i32 bound to BOOLEAN spoiler in book_reviews
description:
In books_db.rs create_review (line 463), spoiler is converted to spoiler_int: i32 and bound to the spoiler column. In the postgres schema (db.rs), book_reviews.spoiler is BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false. PostgreSQL will reject binding i32 to BOOLEAN at runtime.

Same pattern as fedistract-xzkb.23 but in a different table.

Fix: bind review.spoiler directly as bool on the postgres path.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/fedistract/fieldwork-db/src/books_db.rs:463-484
